0022600118.text: The Grizzlies (2-0) are off to a strong start and sit 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, while the Kings (0-2) are 14th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back. Memphis is missing Zach Edey (out, ankle) and Cedric Coward is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and is a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (out, calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), and Keegan Murray is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but Memphis won the 2025-26 series 3-1, and the last meeting, on February 23, 2026 in Memphis, ended with the Grizzlies losing 123-114.
